system.description:
The mage optimizes their own living pattern, temporarily sharpening reflexes, boosting strength, or shrugging off fatigue. At rank 2 the caster adjusts simple life functions in their own body. In play this grants a bonus to a Physical Attribute or resistance roll for the scene’s duration.

Dice Pool: Stamina + Athletics (+1 die as a rote)

Adapted to M5 from M20 Life 2; mechanics paraphrased.
